response.justification: Bogdan Szabo is a versatile, experienced full-stack and systems developer with strong DLang, TypeScript, and infrastructure exposure, but his background does not match the core requirement of 8 years of C++ programming experience — his C++ work is limited to a brief 2014-2015 stint and a bachelor's thesis project. He also lacks demonstrated experience leading cloud compute platform strategy, mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers, or owning large-scale distributed infrastructure at the depth this role requires.
strengths: Broad, multi-domain engineering experience (web, mobile, embedded, systems)
Strong track record of technical writing, mentoring, and community teaching (workshops, talks)
Founder-level experience owning an open-source platform (GISCollective) end-to-end
concerns: C++ experience is minimal (~6 months) and far short of the 8-year minimum requirement
No clear evidence of formal technical leadership role over cloud/DevOps teams or large-scale compute platforms
Career shows frequent job changes and diverse focus areas rather than deep specialization in cloud infrastructure architecture

key_factors.factor: Lack of cloud compute platform leadership experience
Strong mentoring and craftsmanship track record
